mintAuthority.summary: XOFm uses StableTokenV2 with minting restricted to broker/validator paths; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay, MentoGovernor as sole proposer, open executor). BorrowerOperations is immutable.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: XOFm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot, immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A: 46358-byte code, owner() empty, EIP-1967 impl and admin slots zero, immutable.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (XOFm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, XOFm owner() = 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; getMinDelay() = 172800; hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, MentoGovernor 0x47036d78bB3169b4F5560dD77BF93f4412A59852) = true; hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) = true (open executor, standard OZ TimelockController). Prior read also confirmed broker() = 0x777A8255cA72412f0d706dc03C9D1987306B4CaD.

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, XOFm owner() resolved to the 172800-second Mento Timelock and BorrowerOperations was confirmed immutable. At block 72127035, the XOFm EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to StableTokenV2 implementation 0x434563b0...850e and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolved directly to the same Mento Timelock, which can replace mint-critical token logic after its two-day delay. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: cap or minter replacement runs through the enforced two-day Mento Timelock, the live full-composition Mento reserve feed provides continuous reconciliation, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced.
